Se estiver participando pela primeira vez, [leia o regulamento da WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/portuguese-brazilian/) antes da competição e aprenda a competir [assistindo o vídeo](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UHqunxu3rOU). Não há idade mínima ou máxima para participação, mas competidores menores de 18 anos só podem participar com a presença de um responsável legal. Ao se inscrever, você autoriza que a ABRACM, WCA, seus parceiros e apoiadores do campeonato utilizem a sua imagem nas fotos e filmagens que forem feitas no evento, de forma gratuita, inclusive para fins comerciais. # English: Your registrarion will only be apporved on the WCA website after the payment confirmation, which must be made in advance - more information in the [Register](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/GuaraGarage2026/register) tab. If this is your first time competing, [read the WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) before the competition and learn how to compete by [watching this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-81VRLyYhbQ). There is no minimum or maximum age for participation, but underage competitors can only participate with the presence of a legal guardian. By registering, you authorize ABRACM, WCA and their partners to use your image in the photos and videos taken at the event, free of charge, including for commercial purposes.

items.name: SCS1 Almaty Open Air 2019
items.information: Летние соревнования будут проводиться на открытом воздухе на территории жилого комплекса возле Школы спидкубинга. Будут расставлены шатры защищающие участников от солнца и дождя. На соревнования необходимо взять с собой солнцезащитный крем и головоломки, которые вы будете собирать. На территории есть детская площадка и футбольное поле, где можно будет поиграть (мячи не предоставляем). Официальная церемония открытия состоится 20 июля 2019 года в 10:15. За участие всем будут выданы крутые памятные медали, а за призовые места во всех дисциплинах предусмотрены призы и медали! Summer competitions will be held outdoors in a residential complex near the School of speedcubing. Tents will be placed to protect participants from the sun and rain. Please take with you sunscreen and puzzles that you are going to solve. Onsite there is a children playground and a football field where you can play (balls are not provided) The official opening ceremony will take place on 20 July 2019 at 10:15. For participation everyone will be given a cool commemorative medals and for taking a podium of every event there are prizes and medals!

items.information: ##Português **Atenção:** Esta competição terá limite de competitores. Inscreva-se somente se você tem **certeza que irá participar**. Em caso de desistência, por favor **entrar em contato com o delegado (matcasvia@gmail.com)**. Pagamento da taxa via PIX: matcasvia@gmail.com Enviar comprovante para o e-mail: matcasvia@gmail.com Envie o comprovante com o nome do competidor. Alunos do EEEI Prof. Pedro Mazza terão inscrição gratuita e terão de informar no campo de comentários que são alunos e comprovar no dia da competição. Para inscrições no local, favor levar documento que comprove sua identidade. **Aviso**: Ao se inscrever para a competição, você automaticamente se disponibiliza para atuar como juiz, runner e/ou embaralhador quando solicitado. A recusa não justificada poderá acarretar em desclaificação (DNF) de um ou mais eventos de acordo com a regra [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1f2). ##English **Attention:** This competition will have a limit of competitors. Sign up only if you are **sure you will attend**. In case of withdrawal, please **contact the delegate (matcasvia@gmail.com)**. Payment with PIX method: matcasvia@gmail.com Send the payment proof to E-mail: matcasvia@gmail.com Send the proof with the competitor's name. Students of EEEI Prof. Pedro Mazza will have free registration and will have to inform in the comments field that they are students and prove it on the day of the competition. To register on site, please bring a document that proves your identity. **Warning:** By registering for the competition, you automatically make yourself available to act as a judge, runner and/or scrambler when requested. Unjustified refusal may result in disqualification (DNF) of one or more events according to rule [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1f2).

items.information: A inscrição é aberta a qualquer pessoa, de qualquer nacionalidade. Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram feitos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos você compete e no outro ajuda a embaralhar ou sendo juiz. **ATENÇÃO:** Para acessar o local do evento **será necessário informar o CPF e nome** tanto do competidor quanto de seus acompanhantes. Estes dados deverão ser incluídos na caixa de comentários, durante a inscrição. Inscrições sem estas informações não serão aceitas **ATENÇÃO:** Competidores menores de 16 anos devem estar acompanhadas por um responsável. Ressaltamos que a competição ocorrerá em um espaço público, e a organização não se responsabiliza pela supervisão das crianças. --- Registration is open to any person, from any country. With a view to the smooth running of the competition, by registering for a category, you also undertake to help as a judge or scrambler in that category (as provided for in the WCA rules). In this way, the competition becomes self-sustaining, and the activities are divided among all participants, not becoming heavy for just a few. At least two groups were made in each modality. In one of the groups you compete and in the other you help to scramble or judge. **ATTENTION:** To access the competition's venue it **will be required to inform an ID number** for both the competitor and their guests. This information must be included in the comment section of your registration. Registers without this data will not be accepted **ATTENTION:** Competitors under 16 must be accompanied by a guardian. Please note that the competition will take place in a public space, and the organization is not responsible for supervising children.

No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors should be familiar with the WCA regulations.

items.information: **UPDATE** (March 9): The competition has reached the 60-competitor limit, and a number of people now have registrations on the waiting list. Registration has now been closed. In the event of any cancellation, we will accept people from the waiting list in the order in which they have paid the registration fee. STMHS is holding its first WCA competition in May! This competition is planned to help lower the costs of graduation caps and gowns for seniors in STMHS and bring some love to Connecticut cubing. (And then some!) The events consist of some NxNxN puzzles (2x2 up to 5x5, including 3x3 Blindfolded) as well as more unorthodox puzzles (Skewb, Square-1, Pyraminx). 2x2 and 3x3 will have two rounds while the rest of the events will only have one round. Guests are welcome, though it will be appreciated to inform us on how many each competitor will plan on having with them on their registration forms. To the right of the venue is New London High School which has a free parking lot, though its capacity becoming full throughout the day is unknown.

items.information: **Português** Será um prazer recebê-los e temos algumas dicas para vocês, competidores e acompanhantes: - Chegue ao local da competição 30 minutos antes de modalidade que participará; - O cubo que você irá competir deve estar em bom estado, portanto, cuide bem dele; - Se tiver alguma dúvida, não hesite em perguntar. A nossa competição é formada por alguns competidores experientes, mas sempre teremos espaço para novos cubistas. - Taxas de inscrição não serão devolvidas em nenhuma circunstância. - Não serão aceitas inscrições no local. - Procure se divertir bastante! **English** It will be a pleasure to receive you and we have some tips for you, competitors and companions: - Arrive at the competition site 30 minutes before the modality that will participate; - The cube you will be competing in must be in good condition, so take good care of it; - If you have any questions, do not hesitate to ask. Our competition is made up of some experienced competitors, but we will always have room for new cubists. - Registration fees will not be refunded under any circumstances. - On-site registrations will not be accepted. - Try to have a lot of fun!

items.name: Saint-Augustin A 2025
items.information: ## [FR] ### Série Saint-Augustin 2025 Un week-end, deux compétitions! Nous organisons cette série de compétitions sur deux jours, pour offrir une variété maximale d'épreuves! Vous pouvez choisir entre [Saint-Augustin 2025 A](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SaintAugustinA2025/) (samedi) et [Saint-Augustin 2025 B](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SaintAugustinB2025/) (dimanche). Ces compétitions ont des événements différents. Vous ne pourrez participer qu'à ***une seule*** de ces deux compétitions. ***Si vous tentez de vous inscrire à plus qu'une de ces compétitions, une seule de vos inscriptions sera acceptée***. ### Rappels concernant l'inscription Vous devez vous inscrire et payer les frais d'inscription avant que votre inscription ne soit acceptée. Les inscriptions non payées ne seront pas acceptées. Voir les sections **Liste des compétiteurs** et **Liste d'attente** au bas de cette page pour plus de détails. ### Liste de diffusion Veuillez suivre [Speedcubing Canada](https://speedcubingcanada.org/fr) sur les réseaux sociaux et/ou vous inscrire à notre [liste de diffusion](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) pour vous tenir au courant des annonces de compétitions. ### Avis de droit à l'image Les participants aux compétitions de Speedcubing Canada consentent à ce que leurs images soient utilisées par Speedcubing Canada et ses partenaires dans de cadre de la promotion de ses activités notamment sur les réseaux sociaux et autres plateformes numériques. ## [EN] ### Saint-Augustin 2025 Series One weekend, two competitions! We are running this two-day competition series, to offer the most event variety we can! You can choose between [Saint-Augustin 2024 A](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SaintAugustinA2025/) (Saturday) or [Saint-Augustin 2025 B](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SaintAugustinB2025/) (Sunday). These competitions are have different event sets. You will only be able to compete in ***one*** of these two competitions. ***Attempting to register for more than one of these competitions will result in only one of your registrations being accepted.*** ### Registration Reminders You must register and pay the registration fee before your registration can be accepted. Unpaid registrations will not be accepted. Please see the **Competitor List** and **Waiting List** sections near the bottom of this page for more details. ### Mailing List Please follow [Speedcubing Canada](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) on social media and/or join our [mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements. ### Notice of Filming and Photography Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTM5MTEzLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--46ca470428704f3721815eb9f2d89e841eb13ec4/Saipan%20Open%202026%20logo.png) ### Håfa Adai, and welcome to the first ever competition in the Northern Mariana Islands! 🇲🇵 This competition serves as the premier competition for speedcubing in the Northern Mariana Islands. We welcome participants of all ages, skill levels, and nationalities to participate. * It is recommended you register as soon as possible to save a spot. * Be sure to familiarize yourself with the WCA regulations. If this is your first official competition, [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8) will provide you with most of the information you need. * If you are a first time competitor it is highly encouraged to be present for the competitor tutorial at 11:20 AM. --- ### 하파 아다이! 북마리아나 제도에서 열리는 첫 번째 대회에 오신 것을 환영합니다! 🇲🇵 이 대회는 북마리아나 제도 최고의 스피드큐빙 대회입니다. 모든 연령, 실력, 국적의 참가자를 환영합니다. * 자리를 확보하려면 가능한 한 빨리 등록하는 것이 좋습니다. * WCA 규정을 꼭 숙지하세요. 공식 대회에 처음 참가하시는 분이라면 이 [영상](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8)이 필요한 정보의 대부분을 제공해 드릴 것입니다. * 처음으로 경쟁에 참가하는 경우 오전 11시 20분에 시작되는 경쟁자 튜토리얼에 참석하는 것이 좋습니다.

items.information: さいたま2018は，3x3x3キューブのほか，普段頻繁にはない種目を複数ラウンド開催することをテーマとした大会です。開催種目は，3x3x3，7x7x7，3x3x3目隠し，メガミンクスが2ラウンド，スキューブ，スクエア1が3ラウンドです。 本大会では多くのラウンドを開催するため，席を移動することなく5試技連続で行うなど競技進行において新たな試みを予定しています。 Saitama 2018 is characterized by multiple rounds of events less frequently held. It includes two rounds for 3x3x3, 7x7x7, 3x3x3 blindfolded, Megaminx and three rounds for Skewb and Square-1. For smoothness of the competition, we introduce some experimental round procedure (announced later.)

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBb2hMIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--14c85d7c918289412994eb77f529bb474910e16e/image.png) Το Salonica Autumn Open '23 είναι o τελευταίος διαγωνισμός αυτής της σειράς για το 2023 στο δρόμο για τα πρώτα Greek Nationals! Είμαστε πλέον πολύ περήφανοι για την πορεία μας φέτος και συνεχίζουμε δυναμικά. Αυτή τη φορά επισκεπτόμαστε τη βόρεια Ελλάδα και την αγαπημένη μας συμπρωτεύουσα τη Θεσσαλονίκη! Πάρτε τους κύβους σας, ετοιμαστείτε, διαβάστε τους κανόνες και ελάτε στην γιορτή του cubing! Παρακαλoύμε διαβάστε αναλυτικά τις επόμενες σελίδες για να βρείτε όλες τις απαραίτητες πληροφορίες. Σημείωση: Για να θεωρείται ολοκληρωμένη μία εγγραφή πρέπει να ολοκληρωθεί το registration στη σελίδα του διαγωνισμού στην WCA **KAI** να γίνει και η πληρωμή του αντιτίμου συμμετοχής με χρήση της τραπεζικής σας κάρτας μέσω της πλατφόρμας πληρωμών stripe που χρησιμοποιεί η WCA, όπως περιγράφεται στις καρτέλες δίπλα. Δείτε αυτά τα βίντεο για να είστε ετοιμασμένοι: [Εγγραφή στη WCA, σε επίσημο διαγωνισμό και πολλά ακόμα. Οδηγός για πρωτάρηδες.](https://youtu.be/RS768gK0Vrg) [Πώς να είσαι κριτής σε διαγωνισμό κύβων.](https://youtu.be/x5KaXXoh7XI) The Salonica Autumn Open 2023 is the last competition of the Road to the first Greek Nationals series of this year! We are proud of our progress and we strongly continue our effort. Grab your cubes, get ready, read the rules, and come to the cubing celebration! Grab your cubes, study the regulations and attend the greek feast of cubing! Please read the following tabs very carefully! Note: For a registration to be considered valid, the competitor should both register though the WCA site **AND** pay the registration fee as described in the nexts tabs. Please read the following tabs in detail to find all the necessary information.

Στις 24 και 25 Οκτωβρίου 2026, όλοι οι Cubers συναντιόμαστε ξανά για έναν μεγάλο διήμερο διαγωνισμό γεμάτο ταχύτητα, συναγωνισμό και όμορφες στιγμές. Το Salonica Autumn Open 2026 θα αποτελέσει ταυτόχρονα τον δεύτερο διαγωνισμό της **GREEK CUBING LEAGUE**! items.information: A inscrição é aberta a qualquer pessoa, de qualquer nacionalidade. Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram feitos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos você compete e no outro ajuda a embaralhar ou sendo juiz dos competidores. --- Registration is open to any person, from any country. For the competition to run smoothly, by registering for an event, you agree to help as judge, scrambler or runner for this event (as it's said at WCA rules). This way, the competition turns out to be self-supported, and the activities are divided between all competitors, and not charging anyone in excess. Every event will be divided in at least two groups in first round, in a group you'll compete, and in another you'll help as staff.

items.information: REGISTRO A participação nessa competição requer do competidor o conhecimento dos seguintes requisitos: 1. Tomar todos os cuidados referente ao COVID-19 e seguir o que será indicado pelo delegado e organizador da competição; 2. Conhecer as regras da WCA, pois é uma competição oficial; 3. Escolher os eventos a serem registrados com cuidado após revisar as guias Eventos e Cronograma. Preste atenção aos formatos das rodadas e seus cortes/limites; 4. Se inscrever através do site da WCA, realizar o pagamento de forma antecipada e mandar o comprovante para o organizador através do e-mail (joaoszme@yahoo.com.br) indicando o nome completo do participante; 5. Aguardar até que o registro eletrônico seja aceito. Caso não participe mesmo com o pagamento, não haverá devolução do dinheiro. Não serão aceitas inscrições no dia da competição; 6. Em virtude do COVID-19, o local só irá comportar um número máximo de 25 competidores e 25 convidados; 7. Outras informações adicionais verifique no site da WCA ou entre em contato com o organizador através do e-mail (joaoszme@yahoo.com.br), bem como o delegado por meio do e-mail (blima@worldcubeassociation.org). REGISTRATION The participation in this competition requires the comprehension and acceptance of the following requirements: 1. Take all precautions regarding COVID-19 and follow what will be indicated by the delegate and the organizer; 2. Being familiar with the WCA rules, since this is an official competition; 3. Carefully choosing the events. Keep the rounds format, cutoffs and limits in mind. 4. Register through the WCA website, pay in advance and send proof to the organizer via email (joaoszme@yahoo.com.br) indicating the participant's full name; 5. Wait for your registration to be approved online. In the case of not participating and having already paid the registration, no money will be returned. Registrations will not be accepted on the day of the competition; 6. Due to COVID-19, the venue will only hold a maximum of 25 competitors and 25 guests 7. For additional information, check the WCA website or contact the organizer via email, (joaoszme@yahoo.com.br), or the delegate via email (blima@worldcubeassociation.org).

items.information: **English:** CubingAT is happy to announce the first official WCA competition in Salzburg, the Salzburg Open 2020. Fortunately, we found a very strong, dynamic and cool partner (HTBLuVA Salzburg), that finally gave us the possibility to solve some cubes in Salzburg. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the day on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors must be familiar with the WCA regulations. All guests are welcome, but to maintain the security, we would like you to let us know you’re coming. Simply write us your name to this e-mail address: competitions@cubing.at. Alternatively, if you accompany a competitor, they can write your name in the comment of their registration. ___ **Deutsch:** Wir von CubingAT freuen uns sehr euch in der HTBLuVA Salzburg, bei den ersten Salzburg Open 2020 begrüßen zu können. Dank der hervorragenden Zusammenarbeit mit dem routinierten, dynamischen und vor allem aufgeschlossenen Team der HTBLuVA, dürfen wir Speedcuber auch endlich mal in Salzburg Würfel (schnell) lösen. Jeder ist bei diesem Turnier gerne willkommen, unabhängig von der Erfahrung, Alter oder sonstigen Fähigkeiten. Manche Events haben ein spezifisches Zeitlimit, damit wir sicherstellen können den ganzen Tag über im Zeitplan zu bleiben. Alle Gäste sind selbstverständlich gerne willkommen, jedoch würden wir euch aus Sicherheitsgründen bitten, uns ein kurzes Mail mit eurem Namen unter der E-Mail competitions@cubing.at zukommen zu lassen. Oder, falls Ihr einen Teilnehmer begleitet, kann Euer Name bei dessen Anmeldung im Kommentarfeld vermerkt werden. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBb0FJIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--46f5e03d373ccc1422360774454c53cb532739d2/latest%20medium%20def.png, height=3.5cm)

Para mais informações, acesse a aba de [Inscrição](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SamuelAsafe2024/register); - Recomendamos chegar ao local da competição pelo menos 30 minutos antes do início da modalidade em que você irá participar; - Certifique-se de que o cubo que você usará na competição esteja em boas condições, pois cubos danificados podem ser recusados; - Estamos aqui para ajudar! Se você tiver alguma dúvida, fique à vontade para perguntar; - Se este for o seu primeiro campeonato, assista a [este vídeo](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UHqunxu3rOU); - Antes da competição, leia as [Regulamentações da WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/portuguese-brazilian) para estar familiarizado com as regras; - Divirta-se e aproveite ao máximo! ------------------------------------- 🇺🇸 We are excited to welcome you and want to share some essential tips for competitors and companions: - Your registration will be confirmed on the WCA website as soon as the payment is confirmed and the receipt is sent. For more information, visit the [Registration](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SamuelAsafe2024/register) tab; - We recommend arriving at the competition venue at least 30 minutes before the start of the event you will participate in; - Make sure that the cube you will use in the competition is in good condition, as damaged cubes may not be accepted; - We are here to assist you! If you have any questions, feel free to ask; - If this is your first competition, watch [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UHqunxu3rOU); - Before the competition, read the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations) to become familiar with the rules; - Have fun and make the most of the experience! ------------------------------------- #### Organização/Organization: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBc1JMIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--21d308c05a84a509a0a5091b9aae85d06e9b68c7/speedcubes-logo-0.25x.png)

items.information: # The competition was cancelled due to an unexpected situation of lack of resources, which made it both impossible and pointless to carry it out. ¡Te damos la bienvenida a **San Rafael Open 2022**! El cupo **máximo de competidores será de 100**, pudiéndose anotar a todas las categorías que deseen, pagando 1 sola inscripción. Rogamos **puntualidad**, recomendamos llegar 20 minutos antes de cada ronda, de esta manera evitamos demoras. --- Nuestro objetivo en este primer torneo oficial es que los competidores que asistan disfruten al máximo de la actividad, puedan aprender de sus compañeros, aprovechen a actualizar sus tiempos y sigan mejorando. Contamos con la experiencia de haber organizado desde el año 2018 Torneos, Talleres, Juegos, Actividades Cuberas, con nuestro Club Cuberos de Mendoza. Siempre deseábamos ofrecer un torneo oficial, pero los año en pandemia nos lo impidieron. Es por eso que soñamos de todo corazón que todos los competidores, familias, amigos, personas que asistan, disfruten de todo y se lleven una linda experiencia.

[WCA Competitor Tutorial](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dPL3eV-A0ww) • * It is important to carefully write your name, birth date, and other information properly. Otherwise, your registration will not be accepted. If this is your second competition, you must have already claimed your WCA ID.

items.name: Sandnes Open 2024
items.information: ## 🇳🇴 Informasjon Velkommen til Sandnes Open 2024! Denne konkurransen er åpen for alle som ønsker å delta. ### On The Spot Registreringer Det vil bli mulig å registrere seg på lokalet for denne konkurransen. Dette koster 170kr og betaling vil bli gjort gjennom Vipps. Dersom du ikke har en Vipps-konto kommer vi til å tilby andre alternativer. Vi oppfordrer alle allikevel å [registrere seg på nett](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SandnesOpen2024/register) for å sikre at de får plass på konkurransen. ### Førstegangsdeltakere Førstegangsdeltakere er veldig velkommen til å delta. Det stilles ingen krav om hvor rask man må være for å delta, og vi ønsker å se flest mulig velge å delta. --- ## 🇺🇸 Information Welcome to Sandnes Open 2024! The competition is open to all who wish to compete. ### On The Spot Registration Competitors may register on the spot for a fee of 170 NOK. The payment must be made at the time of registration and will preferaly be done though Vipps. Alternatives will be available for competitors who do not have a Vipps-account. We strongly advice all competitors to [register online](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SandnesOpen2024/register) to ensure they are able to get a spot. ### First-Time Competitors First-time competitors are very welcome to compete. There are no requirements in regards to how fast one needs to be to compete, and we would like as many people as possible to attend the competition.

items.information: **Important Information for Participants**: **Location**: The competition will take place at the main school hall. **Arrival Time**: Please ensure that you arrive at the venue at least 30 minutes before your event starts. Latecomers will not be permitted to participate. **Volunteering**: All participants are kindly requested to volunteer during the competition. **First-Time Participants**: If this is your first time participating in a WCA competition or if you're unfamiliar with the competition rules, we strongly recommend reviewing the WCA regulations beforehand. **ID Requirement**: First-time participants are required to bring a scanned copy of their ID card. Please ensure you have this with you. **Cube Requirement**: Participants must bring their own cubes. If you have difficulty bringing puzzles, please contact us in advance so that we can make arrangements for you. **International Participants**: If you are a citizen from outside India, please submit both a physical and photo copy of your ID. We look forward to seeing you at the competition! If you have any questions or concerns, please don't hesitate to reach out to us.

items.information: "Santa Ana Open 2022" sera la primera competencia del año 2022 en el pais. Con protocolos de Bioseguridad nacionales y los establecidos por la WCA, "Santa Ana Open 2022" busca mantener el desarrollo del speedcubing en El Salvador de la manera mas segura posible. **- Se aceptará un máximo de UN acompañante por competidor.** **- Se tomará la temperatura a la entrada de la competencia.** **- El uso de mascarilla es obligatorio en todo momento dentro de la competencia.** ____ "Santa Ana Open 2022" will be the first competition of 2022 in the country. With national and WCA's Bio Security guidelines, "Santa Ana Open 2022" is aiming to further develop speedcubing in El Salvador in the safest way possible. **-Only ONE guest per competitor will be allowed.** **-Temperature will be taken at the venue entrance.** **-Protective mask MUST be worn at all times at the competition venue.**

Returning competitors are considered to have a WCA ID that is from 2024 or earlier. All competitors must still follow all registration requirements for their registration to be considered complete. Registrations will be accepted based on the following: * 30% of spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are reserved for new competitors. * Initially, 70% of spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are available for returning competitors on a first come, first serve basis. * If greater than 30% of new competitors register before 70% of spots are filled by returning competitors, any additional new competitors will be accepted on a first come, first serve basis alongside returning competitors. * If the spots reserved for new competitors are not filled by new competitors before registration closes two weeks prior to the competition, remaining spots, up to the competitor limit, will be accepted from registered returning competitors. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NjE0NzksInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--f938fd3d24075ff0dad669905227919e8d0f6a30/Snip20241111_14.png)

Es un honor invitarlos al "Campeonato de Verano Santiago 2026". Esta competencia es la oportunidad perfecta para que los competidores afinen sus estrategias, midan su nivel y se familiaricen con el ambiente de competencia en el Gimnasio Olímpico Fernando González. Más que una competencia, es una jornada de comunidad y aprendizaje abierta para competidores, familias y amigos. ¡Los esperamos de la mejor manera! **English** Attention, cubing community! It is an honor to invite you to "Campeonato de Verano Santiago 2026". This competition is the perfect opportunity for competitors to refine their strategies, gauge their skill level, and familiarize themselves with the competitive atmosphere at the Gimnasio Olimpico Fernando Gonzalez. More than just a competition, it's a day of community and learning open to competitors, families, and friends. We look forward to seeing you there!

items.information: **(Português) Brasileiro** Chegou o Santos Mágico Open! Convidamos todos os cubistas para participar da primeira edição deste evento repleto de desafios, velocidade e muita diversão. Sua inscrição só será aprovada no site da WCA após a confirmação do pagamento correto, que deverá ser efetuado de forma antecipada - mais informações abaixo em "Requisitos para inscrição" (e na hora da inscrição). Se tiver dificuldades em se inscrever, veja como fazer neste [vídeo](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wLE2OFf9nh8). É muito importante que você conheça todo o regulamento, que podem ser lido [aqui.](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/portuguese-brazilian/) Teremos premiação para todas as modalidades oficiais e premiação extra-oficial para as modalidades 'Feminino' e 'Iniciante', que tomarão como referência a classificação geral na modalidade '3x3x3'. **English** The Santos Mágico Open has come! We invite all cubers to take part in the first edition of this event, filled with challenges, speed, and lots of fun. Your registration will only be approved in the WCA website after payment confirmation, which must be made in advance - more information below in "Registration requirements" (and during the registration). If you have any problem on how to register, take a look at this [video.](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wLE2OFf9nh8) It is very important that you know the regulations, which may be read [here.](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) We will have awards for all official events, and also unofficial awards to the events 'Female' and 'Beginner', which will consider the final ranking in the '3x3x3' event.

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBdUplIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--92701aef7af516be4361993a7c4150fa9e22ea2d/image.png) # This competition features easy and popular events, making it perfect for newcomers. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NjA3NzIsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--1ce2d0d5715009d578d2d8e7e5719e7d7b032738/newcomers2025.png) **First Time Competitors:** All newcomers must be familiar with the WCA Regulations before competing. There is a video [here](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xK2ycvTfgUY&ab_channel=SpeedcubingCanada) for a basic rundown of a competition. Registrations will be accepted based on the following: * 50% of spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are reserved for new competitors. * Initially, 50% of spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are available for returning competitors on a first come, first serve basis. * If greater than 50% of new competitors register before 50% of spots are filled by returning competitors, any additional new competitors will be accepted on a first come, first serve basis alongside returning competitors. * If the spots reserved for new competitors are not filled by new competitors before registration closes two weeks prior to the competition, remaining spots, up to the competitor limit, will be accepted from registered returning competitors. **Judging:** All competitors are expected to help at this competition. We will have a judging tutorial at the beginning of the day. All competitors will be assigned to judge 1 group of each of the events they are competing in. There will also be draw prizes throughout the day to encourage competitors to stay after their round is done. **Mystery event:** There will be a mystery event at lunch. You only need to know how to solve a 3x3 to participate. **4x4** There will be no cutoff for 4x4 at this competition. The cumulative time limit is 20 minutes. You may take over 10 minutes to do a single solve if you let your judge know beforehand. 4x4 is scheduled such that overflow into lunch is acceptable so everyone can get results. --- We ask attendees to limit themselves to one guest per competitor if possible so that we do not go over capacity limits for this venue which is 160 people. Attendance is not required for the entire competition, however please arrive at least 15 minutes before your event's planned start time. Please bring your own cubes for the events you are competing in. items.name: Save Ramir Cubing Kazakhstan 2023
items.information: Соревнование проводится с благотворительной целью. Все вырученные средства пойдут в помощь сбору средств на лечение 3-летнего ребенка с инвалидностью Рамира Ковалевского, с диагнозом «Спинальная мышечная атрофия 2 типа», который нуждается в самом дорогостоящем лекарственном препарате в мире, ZOLGENSMA. Главный спонсор соревнования – компания «Леовит». Соревнование проводится при поддержке школы №157 и общественного фонда «Alem Asar».. Смотрите наш аккаунт в Instagram (https://instagram.com/almaty_cubers), чтобы узнавать новости и подробную информацию о соревновании! Соревнование будет проходить в спортзале школы №157. Будем рады видеть вас на соревновании! Жарыс қайырымдылық мақсатында өткізеді. Жарыстан бүкіл түскен қаражат спиналды бұлшық атрофия диагнозына шалдыққан мүгедекке 3 жасар бала Рамир Ковалевскийге әлемде ең бағалы дәрі «ZOLGENSMA» сатып алу үшін қаржы жинауға және көмектесуге бағыттайды Жарыстың бас демеушісі – «Леовит» компаниясы. Жарыс мектептiң №157 мен «Alem Asar» қоғамдық қорының көмегiмен өткiзіледi. Біздің Instagram аккаунтымыздың парақшасында (https://instagram.com/almaty_cubers) жаңалықтар және жарыс туралы ақпарат көре аласыздар! Жарыс мектептің №157 спорт залында өткізіледі. Сіздің жарысқа белсенді ат салысып қатысқаныңызға қуаныштымыз! The competition is organised for charity. All the proceeds made from the competition will be spent for fundraising for helping 3-years old kid, Ramir Kovalevsky, in his spinal muscular atrophy medical treatment to purchase him the most expensive cure in the world, ZOLGENSMA. The Leovit company is the main sponsor of the competition. The competition is organised with the help of school #157 and Alem Asar social foundation. Watch our posts in our Instagram account (https://instagram.com/almaty_cubers) to learn the news and more information about the competition! The competition will be set in the sports hall of the school #157. We will be happy to see you at the competition!

items.information: ###Português O Schoolmark Open está de volta! Com algumas mudanças e surpresas, porém com a mesma atmosfera que tornou as primeiras edições tão boas! Algumas informações importantes: * É imprescindível entender as regras, conforme **[Regulamento da WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/)** * A competição é aberta a qualquer pessoa que deseje participar, indepentende de idade, nacionalidade, ou velocidade de resolução. * Além disso, a competição também é aberta a acompanhantes e espectadores. Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram feitos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos você compete e no outro ajuda a embaralhar ou sendo juiz dos competidores. **Atenção**: Esta competição terá limite de competitores. Inscreva-se somente se você tem **certeza que irá participar.** Em caso de desistência, por favor **entrar em contato com a organização ([felipeqcardim@gmail.com](mailto:felipeqcardim@gmail.com))** As inscrições deverão ser pagas **via Stripe** na aba de **Inscrever.** ###English Schoolmark Open is back! With a few changes and surprises, but with the same atmosphere that made the first editions so great! Some important information: * It's essential to understand the rules, as in the **[WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/)** * The competition is open to any person that wants to participate, independent of age, nationality, or solving speed. * Besides that, the competition is also open to guests and spectators. For the competition to run smoothly, by registering for an event, you agree to help as judge, scrambler or runner for this event (as it's said in WCA rules). This way, the competition turns out to be self-supported, and the activities are divided between all competitors, and not charging anyone in excess. Every event will be divided in at least two groups in first round, in a group you'll compete, and in another you'll help as staff. **Attention**: This competition has a competitor limit. Sign up only if you are **sure you will attend**. items.name: SeaHorse Vallarta 2024
items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBb0Z0IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--b0b41adcf5d4f6f1ea7f7c8838508e1b81430c53/1.png) # **SeaHorse Vallarta 2024** **Español** ¡Bienvenidos a SeaHorse Vallarta 2024, la primera competencia celebrada en Puerto Vallarta! Es un honor darles la bienvenida a este emocionante evento donde los aficionados al cubo de Rubik de diversas partes del país podran convivir en este bello puerto y poder demostrar sus habilidades y rapidez. Por lo tanto, todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados y entender el [reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/) antes de la competencia. **Ingles** ¡Welcome to SeaHorse Vallarta 2024, the first competition held in Puerto Vallarta! It is an honor to welcome you to this exciting event where Rubik Cube fans from different parts of the country will be able to coexist in this beautiful port and demonstrate their skills and speed. This competition is recognized as an official competition of the World Cube Association. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with and understand the [WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/) prior to competition.

Please see Registration Requirements below for instructions and when registration opens. We will be having an odd mix of main, side and blind events in this One Day, One Stop, All-Out Total Non-Stop Action-Based Competition so be sure to stick around for all sorts of weird and unique tastes of skill, fortitude and perseverance!! **All New Competitors** If this is your first time competing, or the first time your child or ward is competing, please ensure to bring with ID (card, book, passport, birth certificate) so that we can verify that the name is spelled correctly, the Date of Birth is correct, and the Nationality is correct. You are welcome to ask other competitors if you can borrow their puzzle for a certain event, but there is no guarantee.

items.name: Sedgefield Coastal Challenge 2026
items.information: **Welcome to Sedgefield Coastal Challenge 2026!** **SPECTATORS** Spectators are welcome and can attend for free! Bring your family and friends to support! ​ **VOLUNTEERING** Please note that **all competitors** are required to assist with volunteering during the competition - either in the role of "runner", "judge" or "scrambler". These roles will be explained as part of the "New Competitor Tutorial", but you can take a look at [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8). ​ **IMPORTANT NOTE ON VOLUNTEERING ASSIGNEMENTS** Please also check [Competition Groups](https://www.competitiongroups.com/) to see what groups you are in for competing as well as your running, judging and scrambling assignments. If you cannot make any of your assignments, it is **your** responsibility to find a replacement, and you must have a good reason for not being around for your assignment. Keep Competition Groups open during the day to ensure you never miss an assignment accidentally.

items.information: Information DK Der vil være skilte på hoveddøren, og dørene åbner kl. 9:30. Transport: Der er parkeringspladser ved venuen. Det er nemt at komme til venuen ved offentlig transport da der er mange togforbindelser til Slagelse St. Nærmere informationer kan findes på rejseplanen.dk, hvor destinationen kan sættes til stoppestedet 'Selandia'. Der er ca. 20 minutters gang fra Slagelse St. Mad: Der ligger en McDonald's og Burger King 2 km fra gymnasiet, og en Lidl 600 m fra gymnasiet. Overnatning: Det er ikke muligt at overnatte på venue. Information EN Follow the signs at the main entrance. The venue will open at 9 AM. Transport: There are parking spots at the venue. It is easy to commute to the venue by public transport, as many trains stop in Slagelse. You can take a train directly from the train station at Copenhagen Airport to Slagelse St., or a train from Copenhagen Airport to Copenhagen Central Station, and then a train to Slagelse St. Further information can be found on rejseplanen.dk, where the destination can be set to the bus stop 'Selandia' or Slagelse St. The walk from Slagelse St. to the venue is around 20 minutes. Food: There is a McDonald's and Burger King 2 km from the venue, and a grocery store 600 m from the venue. Accommodation: It is not possible to sleep at the venue, but there are following options: Danhostel Slagelse (1,5 km) (http://danhostel-slagelse.dk/) Hotel Frederik d.II (2,1 km) (http://www.fr2.dk/) Hotel Antvorskov (3,2 km) (http://www.hotelantvorskov.dk/en/)

items.information: Dear competitors and guests! 1. The official opening ceremony will be held on June 7, 2018 at 7 pm. According to our idea, it will be held at the main square of the city. For the ceremony we will prepare a special show with the famous speedcubers. In this regard, we recommend arriving in the city no later than 12.00 hours on June 7. 2. The base fee allows to compete in 2x2x2 Cube, 3x3x3 Cube, Skewb, Pyraminx and Clock. For any other event you will need to pay additionally 1000 KZT per event. 3. The winner of each event will receive a prize! =========== Барлық қатысушылар мен қонақтардың назарына !!! 1. Ресми ашылу 2018 жылдың 7 маусымында сағат 19.00-де өтеді, қаланың орталық алаңында өтеді. Салтанатты ашылу рәсімі үшін атақты спидкуберлер қатысуымен шоу-бағдарлама дайындалады. Осыған байланысты біз 7-маусымда сағат 12.00-ден кешіктірмей қалаға келуді ұсынамыз. 2. Негізгі сыйақы 2x2x2 куб, 3x3x3 куб, Skewb, Pyraminx және Clock бойынша бәсекелесуге мүмкіндік береді. Кез-келген басқа іс-шараға қосымша бір оқиға үшін 1000 теңге төлеуге тура келеді. 3. Әр жарыстың жеңімпазы жүлде алады. =========== Дополнительная информация: Внимание всем участникам и гостям!!! 1. Официальная церемония открытия, состоится 7 июня 2018 года в 19.00 ч. По нашей задумке она будет проходить на главной площади города. Для церемонии будет подготовлена специальная шоу программа с участием именитых спидкуберов. В связи с этим рекомендуем прибыть в город не позднее 12.00 часов 7 июня. 2. Регистрационный взнос позволяет принять участие в дисциплинах: 2х2, Rubik's Cube, Skweb, Piraminx, Clock. Для участия в других дисциплинах необходимо оплатить дополнительный взнос по 1000 тенге за каждую дисциплину. 3. За первое место во всех дисциплинах предусмотрены призы

items.name: Shh Seattle 2023
items.information: This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ShhSeattle2023#34809-please-read-competitor-responsibilities) tab. [![PNW Cubing](https://www.pnwcubing.com/uploads/1/9/8/7/19877007/editor/pnwcubing-transparent-01.png?1639634180)](https://www.facebook.com/groups/pnwcubing) This competition is a "PBQ", or "Please Be Quiet" competition. We will only be holding blindfolded events and Fewest Moves, not traditional events like 3x3. As such, this competition is not recommended for first-time competitors, although you are still welcome. You can find other Washington competitions with more standard event lists [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=all&search=washington&state=present&year=all+years&from_date=&to_date=&delegate=&display=list). NOTE: We must have at least 16 competitors in 3BLD to have all three rounds, and 8 competitors must make it to round 2 in order to have the final (as per regulation [9m](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#9m)). We may not be able to hold all three rounds if we do not meet the competitor requirements.

items.information: ### WCAシリーズ大会 「Shonan AM/PM 2024」はWCAシリーズ大会です。 WCAシリーズ大会は複数の大会を一連のシリーズとして扱うもので、それらのうち**一つにのみ**参加できます。 複数に申込んだ場合は、申込完了日時が最も早いものだけを受理し、その他は無効となります。 このページは「Shonan AM/PM 2024」の「AM大会」のページです。 ・ [Shonan AM 2024](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ShonanAM2024)(**このページでは「AM大会」と表記**) ・ [Shonan PM 2024](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ShonanPM2024)(**このページでは「PM大会」と表記**) 各大会の種目、ラウンド数、開場時刻、定員は以下の通りです。 ・AM大会：3x3x3 キューブ 1ラウンド、2x2x2 キューブ 1ラウンド 開場時刻 9:10 定員80名 ・PM大会：3x3x3 キューブ 1ラウンド、3x3x3 片手 1ラウンド 開場時刻 14:10 定員80名 ### 当日の来場時刻 AM大会については、**必ず**受付時間内の9:10から9:40の間にお越しください。 PM大会については、開場時刻の14:10までは会場に入れません。**必ず**14:10から14:40の間にお越しください。 ※会場は一般の企業も使用するオフィスビルのため、**会場前の廊下など建物内での待機はできません。** ### 参加費の支払い方法 参加費は受付時にお支払いください。 支払い方法は現金のみです。 ### 同伴・見学 会場定員の都合上、同伴・見学は承認制をとっています。 今大会の同伴・見学は**1名まで** 、つまり**競技参加者と同伴者の合計2名**でのご来場となります。申込時に同伴者の有無を申告してください。**事前申請のない来場は入場をお断りする場合があります。** 申請の承認は申し込み期間終了後に来場希望総数を集計してから決定いたします。 希望者が多数の場合は年少者の保護者などを優先的に承認することがあります。あらかじめご了承ください。 ### ジャッジ・スクランブラー等の役割分担 WCA大会では、ご自身の競技参加のほか、他者の競技スタッフとしてジャッジやスクランブラ―をはじめとした役割が割り振られます。個人ごとの役割分担表は参加申し込み締め切り後にお伝えします。 競技参加者が年少者の場合など、自身での担当が困難なときには保護者などに代理でご協力いただくことがあります。具体的な作業の流れを確認する時間を大会当日に設けますので、不慣れな方は必ずご参加ください。 関連競技規則[1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/japanese/#1e2)および 競技規則[1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/japanese/#1f2) ### WCA Series Competitions Shonan AM/PM 2024 are recongnized as WCA series competitions. WCA series competitions are a series of multiple competitions. You can participate in **only one** of them. If you register for more than one competition in a series, only the earliest registration will be valid, and the others will be invalid. This page is for Shonan AM 2024. [Shonan AM 2024](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ShonanAM2024) (**In this page, called "AM"**) [Shonan PM 2024](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ShonanPM2024) (**In this page, called "PM"**) The events, number of rounds, opening time, and maximum number of players for each event are as follows: AM : 3x3x3 Cube 1 round, 2x2x2 Cube 1 round, open at 9:10, limit of competitors 80 PM : 3x3x3 Cube 1 round, 3x3x3 One-Handed 1 round, open at 14:10, limit of competitors 80 ### Arrival Information For the AM competition, **please be sure to arrive during check-in hours between 9:10 and 9:40.** For the PM competition, **please be sure to arrive during check-in hours between 14:10 and 14:40.** Competitors won't be allowed to enter until 14:10. *Other business company office is near the venue. Do not stay in the building hallway before check-in. ### How to pay the participation fee Please pay the participation fee at check-in. Payment must be made in cash only. ### Limit of non-competitor Guest Guest entry requires approval due to venue capacity. Each competitor may request bringing up to one non-competitor guest with prior declaration on the registration. **Guest without prior application may be refused entry. ** Approval of your request will be determined after the total number of attendees requested is fixed after the registration period ends. If there are a large number of applicants, gardians of minors might be prioritized. ### The roles of judge and scrambler According to regulations [1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1e2) and [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1f2), all competitors must be prepared to perform duties as judges, scramblers and other rolles required. For younger competitors or those unable to fulfill these roles, we may ask parents or guardians to assist on their behalf. Staff procedures will be lectured at the venue.

items.information: ### Português **Atencão:** Chegamos ao limite de inscrições, isso significa que novas inscrições serão aceitas **somente caso haja alguma desistência**. Neste caso, entraremos em contato com todos os inscritos não confirmados via e-mail, daremos um período para que respondam manifestando interesse, e aprovaremos as inscrições pela ordem que foram feitas, mediante pagamento da taxa de inscrição (R$20). Esta competição possui **limite de inscrições**, em caso de desistência, **entre em contato com a organização ([fcardim@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:fcardim@worldcubeassociation.org))** para que a vaga possa ser disponibilizada para outra pessoa. #### Utilização de imagem Há possibilidade de filmagem e fotografias durante a competição, por parte do shopping ou veículos de mídia autorizados. Ao se inscrever, você concorda que sua imagem pode ser utilizada pelo shopping ou seus parceiros, com fins monetários ou não, sem compensação ou crédito necessário. Ao manter sua inscrição, você também reconhece a leitura e ciência deste aviso. ### English: **Attention:** We have reached the competitor limit, which means that new registrations will only be accepted **if there is a cancellation**. In that case, we'll reach out to all not confirmed registered competitors through email. We'll give a time window answer, saying they're still interested in participating, and we'll approve the registrations in the order they happened, after paying the registration fee (R$20). This competition has a **competitor limit**, in case of withdrawal, **contact the organization team ([fcardim@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:fcardim@worldcubeassociation.org))** so your spot can be given to someone else. #### Image use It's possible there will be photography and filming at the event, done by the mall or authorized media outlets. By registering, you agree that your image might be used by the shopping mall or its partners, for monetary gain or other purposes, without compensation or credit necessary. By keeping your registration, you also recognize to have read and granted permission to this.

Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram feitos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. For the competition to run smoothly, by registering for an event, you agree to help as judge, scrambler or runner for this event (as it's said at WCA rules). This way, the competition turns out to be self-supported, and the activities are divided between all competitors, and not charging anyone in excess. Every event will be divided in at least two groups in first round, in a group you'll compete, and in another you'll help as staff. **ATTENTION:** This competition will not have the 3x3x3 Cube as one of it's events, only the ones known as side events, that said, it is not a competition indicated for beginners

items.information: A inscrição é aberta a qualquer pessoa, de qualquer nacionalidade. Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Em um dos grupos você compete e no outro ajuda a embaralhar ou sendo juiz. **ATENÇÃO:** Está é uma competição que não terá o Cubo 3x3x3 como uma de suas modalidades. **ATENÇÃO:** Devido ao tamanho do local da competição, apenas um acompanhante será permitido por competidor. Façamos a competição ser possível para todos os competidores! Esta competição funcionará da seguinte maneira: Os competidores poderão fazer quantas modalidades queiram, contanto que se atentem ao limite cumulativo de **30 minutos** para todas as suas tentativas. Cada competidor será alocado em um grupo (1, 2 ou 3), no qual irá competir. Nos demais grupos, o competidor deverá, obrigatoriamente, atuar como juiz, embaralhador ou corredor, sob a condição de ter seus resultados desqualificados caso se recuse. Apenas o primeiro colocado de cada modalidade será premiado. --- Registration is open to any person, from any country. With a view to the smooth running of the competition, by registering for a category, you also undertake to help as a judge or scrambler in that category (as provided for in the WCA rules). In this way, the competition becomes self-sustaining, and the activities are divided among all participants, not becoming heavy for just a few. At least two groups were made in each modality. In one of the groups you compete and in the other you help to scramble or judge. **ATTENTION:** This competition will not have the 3x3x3 Cube as one of its events. **ATTENTION:** Due to the size of the competition's venue, only one guest will be allowed per competitor. Please do not bring more guests than the allowed quantity, let's make the competition possible for all competitors! This competition will work as follows: Competitors may attempt as many events as they wish, as long as they adhere to the cumulative time limit of **30 minutes** for all their attempts. Each competitor will be assigned to a group (1, 2, or 3) in which they will compete. In the other groups, the competitor must serve as a judge, scrambler, or runner; refusal to do so may result in disqualification of their results. Only the first-place finisher in each event will receive a prize.

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBdWlFIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--43e30f5cc65d1df2973f94fb32cb7e25100b1ee1/New%20Project%20(3)%20(2).png) ###### Español ¡**Silence in Nayarit 2024**! La primera competencia oficial en Nayarit especializada en eventos silenciosos se llevará a cabo en la ciudad de Tepic el sábado 21 y domingo 22 de septiembre de 2024. Silence in Nayarit 2024 reunirá a cuberos de todo el estado de Nayarit y más allá, brindándoles la oportunidad de mostrar su destreza y competir en los eventos oficiales más difíciles. Tanto si eres un principiante como un profesional experimentado, este torneo ofrece una oportunidad para que todos demuestren sus habilidades. La competencia incluirá una ronda de 3x3x3 Team-Blind, un evento no oficial que promete ser muy emocionante. Además, esta competencia está reconocida oficialmente por la Asociación Mundial del Cubo (WCA). Por lo tanto, es importante que todos los competidores estén familiarizados con el reglamento de la WCA antes de la competencia. ###### English **Silence in Nayarit 2024**! The first official competition in Nayarit specialized in silent events will be held in the city of Tepic on Saturday, September 21, and Sunday, September 22, 2024. Silence in Nayarit 2024 will bring together cubers from all over the state of Nayarit and beyond, providing them with the opportunity to showcase their skills and compete in the most challenging official events. Whether you are a beginner or an experienced professional, this tournament offers a chance for everyone to demonstrate their abilities. The competition will include a 3x3x3 Team-Blind round, an unofficial event that promises to be very exciting. Additionally, this competition is officially recognized by the World Cube Association (WCA). Therefore, it is important that all competitors familiarize themselves with the WCA regulations before the competition.

items.information: A inscrição é aberta a qualquer pessoa, de qualquer nacionalidade. Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram feitos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos você compete e no outro ajuda a embaralhar ou sendo juiz dos competidores. **ATENÇÃO:** Está é uma competição que não terá o Cubo 3x3x3 como uma de suas modalidades, apenas modalidades conhecidas como side events, portanto, não é uma competição indicada para iniciantes. --- Registration is open to any person, from any country. For the competition to run smoothly, by registering for an event, you agree to help as judge, scrambler or runner for this event (as it's said at WCA rules). This way, the competition turns out to be self-supported, and the activities are divided between all competitors, and not charging anyone in excess. Every event will be divided in at least two groups in first round, in a group you'll compete, and in another you'll help as staff. **ATTENTION:** This competition will not have the 3x3x3 Cube as one of it's events, only the ones known as side events, that said, it is not a competition indicated for beginners

items.information: This competition holds only "Please Be Quiet" events - 3x3x3 Blindfolded, 4x4x4 Blindfolded, 5x5x5 Blindfolded, 3x3x3 Multiblind and 3x3x3 Fewest Moves Challenge. As the name suggests, it is crucial to maintain silence during all events. We'll have sufficient amount of breaks when it is ok to make some noise. Эти соревнования включают в себя только дисциплины, на которых необходимо соблюдать тишину - 3х3х3 вслепую, 4х4х4 вслепую, 5х5х5 вслепую, 3х3х3 Мультиблайнд и 3х3х3 на количество ходов. Как следует из названия, чрезвычайно важно сохранять полную тишину во время всех дисциплин. У нас будет достаточное количество перерывов, во время которых можно будет пошуметь.

venue.name: Private residence
venue.address: Address will be provided to registered competitors

items.information: ![](https://i.imgur.com/y4aZ08M.png) **Polski:** Zapraszamy na wyjątkowe zawody z minxami na wolnym powietrzu! Dokładny adres zostanie podany zarejestrowanym zawodnikom poprzez maila kilka dni przed zawodami. Wszyscy zarejestrowani będą proszeni o dołączenie do konwersacji grupowej na Messengerze. Zwróć uwagę, że na tych zawodach NIE będą rozgrywane popularne konkurencje takie jak 3x3x3. Zapoznaj się ze wszystkimi zakładkami przed rejestracją. --------- ![](https://i.imgur.com/i1ldA95.png) **English:** We invite you to the unusual outdoor competition with minxes as the main theme! Specific address will be forwarded to registered competitors. All registered competitors will be asked to join a Messenger group chat. Please note that popular events such as 3x3x3 will NOT be held at this competition. Please check information in all tabs before registrating.

items.information: COVID-19 SAFETY INFORMATION: To prevent overcrowding in the venue, we are limiting each competitor to **one guest only**. Masks are *strongly recommended*. Competitors should not attend the competition if experiencing symptoms of COVID-19, or if they were exposed to someone with COVID-19. When not competing, competitors and spectators should attempt to socially distance whenever possibly by keeping 3 feet away from others. We also encourage you not to share puzzles with other competitors.

items.name: Simi Mini A 2026

venue.name: Simi Valley Public Library
venue.address: 2969 Tapo Canyon Road, Simi Valley, CA

items.information: ### This competition is held in series with [Simi Mini B 2026](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SimiMiniB2026)! You can only compete in one of these competitions! This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SimiMiniA2026#17574-competitor-responsibilities) tab. Spectators can attend for free and can come and go as they please! No registration or check-in process is needed for spectating. This competition is organized in partnership with [West Coast Cubing](https://www.westcoastcubing.com/) and [SpeedCubeShop](https://speedcubeshop.com/). ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBZ0dKIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--60fae70c3e469b91d58257f4370c58af47b487da/scswcc5.png)
